title: Ockhamareto: Pareto-Gated Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Concise Unit-Test Generation with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce \textbf{Ockhamareto}, a single-shot GRPO framework for unit-test generation and selection, based on the principles of \emph{Ockham's Razor} and \emph{Pareto Optimality}. Ockhamareto has two principal components: (i)~a \emph{Pareto-gated Bonus} that rewards only rollouts non-dominated in~(mutation, $-$\#tests) space, and (ii)~\emph{Token-level Segment Credit}, which attributes each test's marginal mutation kills back to the tokens of its unit-test block. On the \emph{UnLeakedTestBench~(ULT)}, Ockhamareto \emph{strictly Pareto-dominates} the strongest RL baseline~(\emph{MIST-RL}). translated_title: 奥卡姆帕累托：基于帕累托门控的段级信用分配用于强化学习生成简洁单元测试
translated_abstract: 我们引入了**Ockhamareto**，一个基于*奥卡姆剃刀*和*帕累托最优*原则的单次GRPO框架，用于单元测试生成和选择。Ockhamareto有两个主要组成部分：(i)一个*帕累托门控奖励*，仅奖励在（变异得分，-$测试数$）空间中非支配的展开结果；(ii)*令牌级段信用*，将每个测试的边际变异杀死归因于其单元测试块的令牌。在*UnLeakedTestBench（ULT）*上，Ockhamareto*严格帕累托支配*最强的RL基线（*MIST-RL*）。此外，它在*每一个*优化目标上都占优，捕获更多错误（在N=5时变异得分为49.9%对比31.3%），使用*更少*的测试（平均2.60对比4.67），从而实现了每测试权衡改进的3.4倍。该优势在四个基准（*HumanEval+*、*MBPP+*、*Co*）上均得到体现。
tldr: Ockhamareto通过帕累托门控奖励和令牌级段信用分配，在生成更少单元测试的同时捕获更多变异错误，实现了对现有RL基线的严格帕累托支配。
en_tdlr: Ockhamareto achieves strict Pareto dominance over existing RL baselines by using Pareto-gated rewards and token-level segment credit assignment, catching more mutation errors with fewer unit tests.
